title: Cut over from mux scaffold to pure terraform-plugin-framework provider
essence: Remove tf6muxserver + tf5to6server from the provider entry point. All betterado_* resources and data sources are now served exclusively by terraform-plugin-framework (protocol 6). The mux bridge, SDKv2 provider factory call, and all SDKv2 ResourcesMap/DataSourcesMap registrations are deleted. Provider version bumped to 2.0.0 (BREAKING: requires Terraform >= 1.x).
